englishTranslation: Chicken hot pot with lemon basil
atAGlance: Lẩu gà lá é is chicken hot pot with peppery lá é herb, often linked with Đà Lạt and Phú Yên. The herb goes in fresh so the broth smells bright.
whatItIs: Lẩu gà lá é is a chicken hot pot scented with lá é, a peppery Vietnamese herb, often with mushrooms or bamboo shoots.
howToEnjoy: Cook the chicken and vegetables first, then add lá é near the end. The fresh herb should perfume the bowl.
howLocalsOrder: Lẩu gà lá é is a chicken hot pot scented with lá é, the lemon-basil-like herb tied to central highland cooking. Ask for the herb-heavy version and choose spice level before the pot starts bubbling.
worthKnowing: Travelers often meet this dish around Đà Lạt, though the herb and style also connect to Phú Yên.
goodToKnow: Lá é is often translated as lemon basil, but its peppery herbal aroma is the point. Add it late so it stays fragrant.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một nồi lẩu gà lá é.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of chicken hot pot with lemon basil.
